title: Chi guardi?…
subtitle: Christmas Eve at the Café Momus: Rodolfo presents Mimì to his friends, Parpignol's toy cart, the supper ordered, La bohème, Act 2

passages.label: Chi guardi? Rodolfo and Mimì; the friends set the table (Lo stesso movimento ma sostenendo, A flat major)
Ecco i giocattoli di Parpignol! Rodolfo brings Mimì to the table (Moderato assai)
Questa è Mimì, gaia fioraia: Rodolfo presents her (Allegretto moderato; Andante mosso, E major)
Digna est intrari: the friends' Latin welcome (Brillante, Poco meno)
Parpignol! The children round the toy cart; the supper ordered (Allegretto giocoso, F major)
The mothers scold the children (Più mosso, D major)
Vo' la tromba: the crying boy; Mimì's custard; the children follow Parpignol (Molto sostenuto; Tempo I, A major)

licences.source: Luigi Illica and Giuseppe Giacosa, libretto of La bohème (1896)
licences.author: Luigi Illica (1857–1919) and Giuseppe Giacosa (1847–1906)
licences.notes: Words as printed in the Ricordi vocal score.

licences.source: G. Ricordi & C. vocal score of La bohème, pages 100-110 (from figure (8), “Chi guardi?”, to the end of page 110, before figure (15), 119 bars)
licences.author: Carlo Carignani (1857–1919), piano reduction
licences.notes: Written out from the printed pages: sung lines and piano each transcribed independently, disagreements settled on the page by a separate judge, then checked against the print and corrected. The print's seven chorus staves are gathered here into four by voice (every note and syllable kept, each group named where it comes in on a shared staff). Tempo from the printed metronome marks; where none is printed, a value chosen as stated in the piece's notes.
